required.name: python3
required.why: runs the deterministic trace aggregation engine (lib/trace-review.py)

optional.name: langfuse
optional.why: the trace store this report reads from
optional.degrade: STOP and tell the user to run `devflow up` - there is no data to report on without it

optional.name: langfuse-keys
optional.why: Basic-auth to the Langfuse public API
optional.degrade: STOP - the engine cannot authenticate without keys
